name: dib
description: Connect Claude to your Dib home: inventory, vehicles, documents, tasks, rooms, and your home profile, via the Dib MCP server.

dib_api_key.title: Dib API key
dib_api_key.description: Your dib_live_* key from dib.io/developers (use a dib_test_* key to hit the sandbox). Stored in your system keychain, never in plaintext settings.
